requiredConstruction: Replace the live integrated low-poly keep family; do not merely decorate its blank slabs.
Use rounded or bevelled overlapping masses with curved shoulders and nested inhabited pods. No primary wall may present as a broad undecorated planar slab in any orbit view.

The source-facing silhouette must read as a fantastical honey civic palace: one tall central lantern, four strongly grouped front bays, stepped shoulder towers, and a broad grounded entrance hierarchy.
Build the portal first as a deep closed honey-arch tunnel. Purple double doors, seam, handles, bee crest, and warm reveal must survive phone scale and remain the highest-contrast front feature.

Build four dominant front bays as visibly separate rounded closed bodies. Each needs a structural gold hex frame, dark occupied recess, amber glazing, roof cage, and actual side return. They must be countable at 000, 045, 315, and phone views.

Wrap a connected exoskeleton of thick hex tubes, diagonal braces, eaves, vertical honey channels, and buttress ribs continuously around corners. At least 65 percent of the visible front wall area and 40 percent of each side must carry honeycomb structure or inhabited cells.
Use scalloped faceted cupolas with amber cores and external rib cages. Avoid simple cones, smooth repeated bulbs, mosque silhouettes, and equal-status perimeter domes.

Use wax-cream inset masonry, deep bronze occupied cavities, bright gold tracery, translucent amber glazing, rich purple enamel, and selective near-white specular highlights. Geometry and value grouping must communicate these materials even if physical transmission is unavailable.

Build honey as attached viscous assemblies: broad source shelf or fillet, thick sagging curtain or tapering strand, convex highlight strip, and weighted teardrop. Honey must visibly connect to an eave or channel and may not resemble a lamp or post.
Author both sides and rear with quiet honey cells, wrapped tracery, an apse entrance/service recess, and honey channels. The rear may be subordinate but not blank.
Real closed geometry must carry identity; runtime image projections, facade cards, disks, planes, and paper edges remain forbidden.
